newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to privatize postal company by decree.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to privatize postal company by decree.

text.p: The Argentine government plans to privatize state postal firm Encotesa by presidential decree, the ruling Peronist Party's whip in the lower house of Congress, Jorge Matzkin, said in comments published Monday.

"The government had decided to wait for Congress to set the regulations on postal services, but since we are delayed, the government will go forward with the privatization," Matzkin said in comments carried by local newspapers.
"The privatization will take place by decree," he added.

The sale of Encotesa has been criticised by former Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo, who has said the privatization is being carried out to benefit businessman Alfredo Yabran, whom he accuses of trying to monopolize the postal sector.
